_about: Everything the pack does not know. The Factory must not fill any of these by inference: each is resolved only by its named resolver, and the resolution is recorded. Status 'Resolved' records Isa's answer; residual questions stay open.

items.question: The pack's author has not seen the Factory's code.
items.resolver: Every card: its puller grounds the work in the code and cites files and commit; a seed whose premise does not hold is returned with evidence under R8
items.isa_answer: The institutions pull the cards and work as a collective; no named role pre-reads the code.

items.question: Current idea and card volumes.
items.isa_answer: Baseline from the analysis; measure live and improve. No study period.

items.question: Trial start date and duration.
items.isa_answer: No trial: build it, use it, monitor and improve (dog-food). Continuous monitoring (C0.15, C4.01).

items.question: Who holds vendor accounts and API keys, and how adapters obtain them.
items.resolver: The puller of C0.05 finds it in the code; confirmed in AR-10
items.isa_answer: The Owner; the keys are hashed in the Factory.
items.residual: [Inference] A one-way hash cannot authenticate an API call, so the Factory must also hold a usable credential, encrypted or in a secret store, and use the hash as a fingerprint. Confirm which is in place.

items.question: What a clean idea is worth.
items.isa_answer: Baseline each idea from the pack's analysis; replace with actual output. The Owner provides the actual costs paid in the real world.
items.decision: Unit USD. Cost: baseline from the cost model, actuals from metering plus Owner-entered invoices, subscriptions and cloud credits. Return: baseline from the idea's Alignment Record, actuals entered by the Owner.

items.question: Is Muse Spark 1.3 served to the Owner's account region (UK or KSA)? [Unverified]
items.fallback: A second route (OpenRouter) and Gemini 3.8 Flash in the same class (docs/idea/value-stream.md §12).

items.question: No-training terms for every model tier used (R15), and their fit with Heliosvera IP.
items.resolver: AR-10, with a qualified adviser where the terms are unclear

items.question: Who owns live operation: incident, restore, hotfix.
items.isa_answer: Live operation must be part of the Factory.
items.decision: Until the Release Gate exists, incidents and restores are top-priority cards pulled by any agent and checked by another family (C0.16); then the Release Gate owns them (C2.03) [PROPOSED]. Hotfixes flow through the Market and Review.

items.question: Which ideas need Isa's ratification, and her weekly attention budget.
Quality standards per institution and tier (maximum markdown rate).
items.decision: Baseline 1 minus the R19 floor per step [PROPOSED], adjusted from live variance.

items.question: Starting licence for menu models that are not in today's mapping. R11 says a new model starts at tier 1 and climbs by stretch cards; §5.1 treats the Artificial Analysis band as the starting prior. The Idea Record does not reconcile the two.
items.decision: [PROPOSED] Artificial Analysis band as the starting prior (§5.1), corrected by live evidence under R5; no replay spend.
